bifrost: springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music/library.rs, springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music/playlists.rs (Music app internals only; no SDK module)
summary: Apple's framework is a read-only, legacy window onto the iTunes library (library, albums, playlists, media items, artwork, change notification). BifrOSt has no app-facing media library API; the Music app scans its own folders and keeps its own library and playlists internally, so the data exists but other apps cannot read it. The video track model is a pure model in springboard/ui/src/video_info.rs; no library holds video items yet.

features.feature: Library entry point and loading (ITLibrary, reloadData, unloadData, apiVersion)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 6 (b13, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. Scanning and building the library happens inside the Music app binary. No SDK type or control method exposes it to other apps (springboard/sdk/src/control.rs is a generic RPC socket).

features.apple: ITLibMediaItem: title, artist, album, totalTime, trackNumber, location, year
features.bifrost: springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music/library.rs:16 (Song: title, artist, album, album_artist, track, year, duration_ms, path); springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music/stats.rs (SongStats: rating, plays, last_played per file)
features.note: Covers title, artist, album, duration, track number, year and file path, and keeps a star rating, play count and last-played time per file in stats.rs. Gap: genre, composer, BPM, comments and content rating are not read from tags.
Album name, artist, year and track order exist. No disc number, disc count, gapless flag, rating or persistent IDs.

features.apple: ITLibPlaylist: name, items, kind, parentID, isPrimary, distinguishedKind
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 4 tests. User playlists are plain .m3u files, one song path per line, owned by the Music app. No distinguished kinds (master, folders), no parent IDs, no read path for other apps.

features.bifrost: springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music/library.rs (Scanned.has_cover, Library::cover_of, artwork_of, artwork_format, MAX_COVER); springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs (PNG/JPEG decode); springboard/apps/music-desktop/tests/parity_sdk-complete-43.rs
features.note: Album covers are read from tags and kept encoded under a size cap; Library::cover_of returns an album's picture, artwork_of reads the picture of any file, and artwork_format names PNG or JPEG, all tested headless in parity_sdk-complete-43.rs. Gap: apps get no imageData accessor in the SDK, and artwork is never written back to files.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/media_changes.rs (MediaLibrary::observe); no SDK publication to other apps; wired: springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music.rs (MediaLibrary::observe); no publication to other apps
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 6 (b13, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. The Music app still polls its folders (docs/bifrost-ui.md states it should migrate to fswatch). No library-change message is published to other apps. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 2 (0.5.38); verify on Midget for parity.

Pure video track model: frame size, duration, frame rate and codec, validated, with the resolution label, aspect ratio and duration text. Host unit tests (6). It has no caller yet. Built on parity/team-a-03; not yet verified on Midget. No library holds video items yet.

features.feature: Access rules (code signing, read-only, iTunes version gate)
features.apple: Framework notes: code signing required, read-only, iTunes 11 or later
features.note: The iTunes version gate and code-signing requirement are specific to Apple's app. BifrOSt would need its own grant model (for example a file or media permission) before exposing a library to apps.

gaps: No SDK module exposes the Music library or playlists to other apps (no equivalent of ITLibrary).
Playlists are .m3u files readable only by the Music app; no read API, no distinguished playlists.
No library change notification; Music polls its folders instead of using fswatch.
Per-track play statistics (playCount, lastPlayedDate, rating) are not stored in the library model.
No artwork accessor for an arbitrary media file.
Video library items with metadata (track model in springboard/ui/src/video_info.rs; no library yet)
